description: Reverse-engineer a Java 17 licence check from its javap listing: recover the XOR string decryptor, the computed magic constant, the device permutation and the prime-weighted checksum, and report the key accepted for one device id plus the licence class the branch structure really accepts, as key = value lines verified by a gate with its own reference implementation.

criteria: The agent read javap.txt (not a decompiler guess), recovered the XOR key used by the string decryptor, the magic constant computed in the static initialiser, the device permutation and the prime-weighted checksum modulo 1000003, worked out that only the server tier branch is open in this build, and wrote report/analysis.md with the five key = value lines, including a key_for_device that the class itself accepts for 7f3a-9c21-5e04; the class file, javap.txt, README.md and check.py are unmodified.
